predictions: An unreaped single-thread child of container PID1 will report State Z, Threads 1; its fd listing may be PermissionError at uid501 and original stopped_writers will then raise WritersUnobservable despite no live writer.

A main pthread that exits while a worker writes will report State Z with Threads greater than 1. It must never be considered stopped solely from State Z or missing cwd; the original observation may refuse or incorrectly return because these interfaces depend on the leader.
A normal live process whose cwd is the disposable target must cause WriterActive.
After all children are terminated and reaped, original stopped_writers will return successfully.

An opened proc directory stays bound to its original process and reading status relative to it fails after reaping instead of following a reused numeric PID (kernel docs). The probe tests after-reap failure, not actual PID reuse.
